en.headline: July rainfall second-highest on record as hikers risk dam discharge
en.dek: Hong Kong recorded 790.3 mm of rain last month, more than double the normal total, while a video showed hikers posing near a powerful flood discharge at Ho Pui Reservoir.
body: Hong Kong recorded 790.3 millimetres of rainfall in July, more than double the normal figure and the second-highest monthly total since records began in 1884, the Hong Kong Observatory said.

The heavy rain was mainly caused by broad troughs of low pressure, active southerly airstreams and tropical cyclones Maysak and Noul. Accumulated rainfall from 1 January to the end of July reached 1,977.6 mm against a normal of 1,468.2 mm for the same period.

A video circulating online showed four hikers near the dam of Ho Pui Reservoir in Pat Heung, Yuen Long. A man and a woman climbed over a railing and walked down steps to the base where water was gushing in a powerful torrent; the woman stood on metal steps with arms outstretched while the man appeared to signal for photos.

A woman at the scene repeatedly warned them to stay away, saying the discharge was dangerous and they could be swept away. The clip drew online criticism for putting rescue workers at risk. Water Supplies Department data showed total reservoir storage at 86.84 per cent of capacity, with 11 of 17 reservoirs full.

zh.headline: 7月雨量創有紀錄以來第二高 有人於河背水塘泄洪口旁拍照
zh.dek: 天文台指上月錄得790.3毫米雨量，超過正常一倍，為1884年有紀錄以來第二高；網上片段顯示有人在元朗河背水塘泄洪口附近危險位置拍照。
body: 香港天文台表示，本港7月錄得790.3毫米雨量，超過正常數字一倍，為1884年有紀錄以來第二高的單月雨量。
天文台指，上月大雨主要受廣闊低壓槽、活躍偏南氣流，以及熱帶氣旋「梅花」及「納沙」影響。由1月1日至7月底的累積雨量達1,977.6毫米，而同期正常為1,468.2毫米。
網上流傳一段約32秒片段，顯示四名行山人士在元朗八鄉河背水塘水壩附近。一男一女翻過欄杆，沿梯級走到泄洪口下方，當時水正猛烈瀉下；女子站在金屬梯級上張開雙臂，男子則似在示意拍照。
現場一名女子多次警告他們遠離，指正在泄洪，非常危險，可能被沖走。片段引起網上批評，指為了拍照將救援人員置於風險。水務署數據顯示全港水塘總存水量達容量86.84%，17個水塘中有11個已滿。
